domain: Regional tourist letting registers, for the six regions where foreign owners actually buy

rules.register: Registro de Turismo de la Comunitat Valenciana

source.name: DOGV
source.ref: Decreto-ley 9/2024 de 2 de agosto del Consell, in force 8 August 2024

key_facts: A favourable municipal report of urbanistic compatibility for tourist use is required.
Registration has five-year validity, renewable with a fresh declaration and updated municipal report.
The registration number must appear in all advertising; failure is a serious infraction.
Letting room by room within a registered VUT is a very serious infraction.
rules.notes: Which specific municipalities have suspended new registrations is municipal-level and must be checked town by town.
rules.statement: Tourist letting register and current position in Comunitat Valenciana.

rules.register: Registro de Turismo de Andalucia, entry by declaracion responsable
key_facts: Municipalities may limit numbers per building, sector, area or period for an overriding reason of general interest.
A statutory prohibition in the community's title or estatutos blocks tourist use.
rules.notes: Entry into force date of Decreto 31/2024 not verified. Which municipalities have adopted caps not verified.
rules.statement: Tourist letting register and current position in Andalucia.

source.name: DOGC
source.ref: Decreto ley 3/2023 de 7 de noviembre, existence confirmed via BOE

rules.notes: BLOCKED. Every Generalitat host (portaljuridic, canalempresa, tramits.gencat.cat) is disallowed to automated fetching. The commonly repeated points, a municipal urbanistic licence required in 262 municipalities, the Registre de Turisme de Catalunya, and existing HUT licences expiring five years after entry into force, are NOT verified. Do not publish anything for Catalunya.
rules.statement: Tourist letting register and current position in Catalunya.

rules.register: Consells insulars, new places via the Consorci Borsa d'Allotjaments Turistics

source.name: BOE consolidated text
source.ref: Ley 8/2012 del Turismo de las Illes Balears, consolidated

key_facts: New tourist places for ETV are rationed through periodic calls, not freely available.
Ley 1/2025 of 13 June 2025 makes failure to include a party prohibition in the contract, and failure to require a disruptive guest to leave within 24 hours, a serious infraction.
rules.notes: Precise moratorium status per island and per building type not verified.
rules.statement: Tourist letting register and current position in Illes Balears.

source.name: BOE consolidated text
source.ref: Ley 6/2025 de 10 de diciembre de Ordenacion Sostenible del Uso Turistico de Viviendas

key_facts: Conditions the activity on municipal urbanistic authorisation.
Provides for suspension of new authorisations in areas declared to have a stressed residential market.
rules.notes: Article numbering, the residential-reserve percentages, the transitional regime and the entry-into-force date all need a direct read. Do not code detail.
rules.statement: Tourist letting register and current position in Canarias.

rules.register: Registro de Empresas y Actividades Turisticas de la Region de Murcia
key_facts: Entry by declaracion responsable. Procedure continuously open, activity may begin on submission with a provisional number.
No regional suspension of new registrations.
CARM confirms express community approval is now needed following Ley Organica 1/2025.
rules.statement: Tourist letting register and current position in Region de Murcia.

penalties.statement: The commonly cited range of 4,000 to 60,000 euros with an Ibiza ceiling of 111,000 is NOT supported and is wrong for the Balearics.

balears.statement: Balearic penalties for marketing tourist stays without authorisation: serious 4,001 to 40,000 euros, very serious 40,001 to 400,000 euros.
balears.notes: Partial: confirmed from an official island council page citing the law, not from the article text itself. There is no 111,000 euro Ibiza ceiling; the statutory ceiling is 400,000.
